Overview

What holds the build together is discipline at the boundaries: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default across the Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing estate, which is what makes the reported delta defensible in audit. In Manufacturing & Industrial the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 quality shapes what data may move, OEE uplift dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
